checks.name: small-shop responses and query counts stay unchanged when another shop grows
actual Prisma plans avoid scanning the large shop for small-shop orders/products
numbered history counts only the selected shop
overlapping product slugs resolve independently for each public shop
membership in both shops does not allow mixing resource IDs
composite tenant FK rejects cross-shop category assignment
foreign memberships and invalid tenant contexts fail closed
empty tenant returns empty history and zero count
large and small tenant histories execute concurrently on shared database workers
small-shop tail latency stays within declared local mixed-load budgets
tenant reads and writes remain isolated during simultaneous cross-shop attempts
catalog first and filtered pages use measured tenant indexes
all 20000 products traverse bounded pages without gaps or duplicate identities
category timestamp and sort ties traverse deterministically
public menu independently pages product and category facets without truncation
deep catalog cursors and foreign/changed-filter cursors stay bounded and scoped
batched modifier pricing matches individual quotes with constant SELECT counts at 1/10/100 lines
full checkout and receipt reads keep constant SELECT counts as distinct order lines grow
repeated product lines keep separate quantities and notes while reusing one batch read
batch pricing rejects cross-product modifiers and foreign-shop products without partial orders
batch data is fresh after price and modifier availability updates
catalog relation queries stay constant as returned page sizes grow
owner order feed queries stay constant as returned rows grow
real payment review, settlement and receipt queries stay constant at 1/10/100 lines
dashboard and paid-order lookups keep fixed query budgets over 1/10/100/500 completed records
500 catalog and menu records traverse bounded pages with fixed per-page budgets
500 quote records use bounded batches and oversized single requests do no database work
500 order-feed rows retain a fixed read budget per chronological page
live membership removal stops subsequent reads

nPlusOne.semantics: Counts include WITH/SELECT statements. Payment 500 measures a single-resource review over a 500-record paid dataset; payment line counts remain capped at 100. Catalog/feed/quote 500 cases traverse bounded pages/batches. Total traversal queries scale with pages, not per-row enrichment.
nPlusOne.limitations: SELECT round trips and total Prisma statements, not PostgreSQL trigger-internal work or O(1) CPU/row transfer. No mock query-count assertions; no production SQL logging enabled.

limitations: Actual repository/service SQL with bounded runtime adapter. Pending/rejected data only. Mixed-load budgets are local regression checks, not production HTTP SLOs or proof of fairness at arbitrary saturation. Does not establish all-query coverage or paid/report throughput.
